What a Great Bar - Very friendly staff!
Jun 2026 • Friends
Caleb, who is one of the owners, and Hoa were very welcoming and friendly, so if you fancy a cold beer in a friendly and air-conditioned environment, I highly recommend you visit The Three Musketeers.

Service:
- As previously mentioned, Caleb and Hoa were very welcoming and friendly.
- Once I ordered my drinks, they were delivered within a couple of minutes.
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- They have both indoor and outdoor seating.
- Indoors: It’s air-conditioned, which is lovely.
- A lovely bar and pool table, which is free to play.
- Seating: High-back padded bar chairs.
- Outdoors: Seating: High-back padded bar chairs and standard high-back padded chairs.
- To keep you cool they have numerous wall-mounted and portable fans.
- During my visit they played some nice upbeat background music, which you can hear indoors and outdoors. This will be great during the World Cup!
- They also have 3 TV’s to watch sporting events.
- The lighting is also really nice. You don’t have the feeling you’re inside a cave.
- Rating: 5/5

My Order:
- 1 x Pint of Huda
- Served ice-cold in a lovely glass
- Price: 60K
- Rating: 5/5

- 1 x Pint of Asahi
- Served ice-cold in an Asahi glass
- Price: 90K
- Rating: 5/5

- 1 x Glass of Red Wine (Vistana, Cabernet Sauvignon)
- Served Chilled as they have a wine cooler.
- Price: 120K
- Rating: 5/5

Overall Rating: 5/5

Additional Information:
- Happy Hour Timings: 16:00 to 19:00
- Happy Hour Deal: Buy 2 beers, get 1 free. This also applies to house spirits and wine.
- Food coming soon 😋 watch this space!
- They’re also planning to install a big screen before the World Cup starts. 🍻⚽️

Good luck Caleb, Vlad & Coco🍻

The staff are young and enthusiastic, nothing is a problem and they really try to please everyone. It’s run by an Australian that has worked in the bar industry for ever and it shows.
